ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The map on the left in the image shows the southeastern United States and the Florida Peninsula, marked with about the 80°W meridian and the 30°N parallel. Jia is located on the eastern coast of the United States near Florida, which accords with the location indication in the question stem that the Space Shuttle “Discovery” was launched from the launch center in the eastern United States. The map on the right is marked with Yi, but in this question the judgment of “Eastern Time in the United States” is mainly based on the eastern United States location where Jia is located and the time difference given in the question stem. The question stem gives: Beijing time is 22:39 on July 26, 2005, and Eastern Time in the United States is 9:39 on the same day. Both are July 26, and Beijing time is 13 hours earlier than Eastern Time in the United States. Beijing time is the standard time of the East Eighth Zone, namely UTC+8. If Eastern Time in the United States is 13 hours later than Beijing time, then its time zone is 8 - 13 = -5, corresponding to the West Fifth Zone. Therefore, the “Eastern Time in the United States” here refers to the standard time of the West Fifth Zone.
